name: tlc-ext-0
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC, TLCExt
VARIABLE x
ASSUME PrintT(<<TLCGetOrDefault(0, 0), TLCGetAndSet(0, LAMBDA old, new : old + new, 1, 0), TLCGetOrDefault(0, 99)>>)
ASSUME TLCDefer(PrintT("deferred") /\ 1 \div 0 = 0)
Init == x = 0
Next == x < 3 /\ x' = x + 1
Inv == AssertEq(TLCNoOp(x), 0) \/ x >= 0
====
config: INIT Init NEXT Next INVARIANT Inv CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
